{{TOC|side||3}}
== General ==

Arma Script Profiler is a Mod that provides the ability to profile [[Scheduler|unscheduled]] SQF Scripts just like how [[Performance_Profiling]] does it for Engine internals.<br>

Once you Capture a Frame the data is put into your Clipboard. To display it properly you need the [[Performance_Profiling#Versions with performance profiling|Profiling build]] of Arma.<br>
When one or multiple Frames were Captured it automatically opens the captureFrame UI and you have to click on "PASTE ALL" to paste your clipboard content and display the data.

{{Clear}}
== Commands ==

<div class="_description cmd">

<h3>createProfileScope</h3>
<dl>
<dt>Description:</dt>
<dd> 
This creates a new scope. Store it in a a [[private]] local variable. Don't store it in a Global Variable!
</dd>
</dl>

<h4>Syntax</h4>
<dl>
<dt>Syntax:</dt>
<dd> '''createProfileScope''' scopeName </dd>
<dt>Parameters:</dt>
<dd class="param">scopeName : [[String]] - The name of your scope. This will be displayed in the output.</dd>
<dt>Return Value:</dt>
<dd> ProfileScope - a proprietary variable Type. This value going out of scope defines the end of the current Scope. So you have to store the result in a local variable.</dd>
</dl>

<h4>Examples</h4>
<dl><dt>Example 1:</dt><dd class="example"><code style="display: block">private _scope = createProfileScope "testScope";</code><!--[[File:ArmaScriptProfiler_profilerLogExample.png|thumb|example output]]--></dd>
</dl>

<h3>profilerCaptureSlowFrame</h3>
<dl>
<dt>Description:</dt>
<dd> 
Captures the first frame that hits the threshold.<br>
The runtime of all scripts in the current Frame are summed up. And if they hit the threshold it triggers a Capture.
</dd>
</dl>

<h4>Syntax</h4>
<dl>
<dt>Syntax:</dt>
<dd> '''profilerCaptureSlowFrame''' threshold</dd>
<dt>Parameters:</dt>
<dd class="param">threshold : [[Number]] - Threshold in milliseconds</dd>
<dt>Return Value:</dt>
<dd> [[Nothing]]</dd>
</dl>

<h4>Examples</h4>
<dl><dt>Example 1:</dt><dd class="example"><code style="display: block">profilerCaptureSlowFrame 2;</code></dd>
</dl>
<h4>Additional Information</h4>
<dl>
<dt>See also:</dt>
<dd class="seealso"><div id="biki-unified-see-also"></div>[[diag_captureSlowFrame]]</dd>
</dl>

<h3>profileScript</h3>
<dl>
<dt>Description:</dt>
<dd> 
A more precise alternative to [[diag_codePerformance]].<br>
This outputs the results as double precision microseconds without any rounding. And it doesn't check for a timeout.<br>
Meaning this WILL freeze your game if you go overboard with it. And it also works in MP.<br>
</dd>
</dl>

<h4>Syntax</h4>
<dl>
<dt>Syntax:</dt>
<dd> '''profileScript''' [code, arguments, runs]</dd>
<dt>Parameters:</dt>
<dd class="param">code: [[Code]] - Your code to run</dd>
<dd class="param">arguments: [[Anything]] - The arguments passed in _this (Warning: This overwrites your _this in your current scope</dd>
<dd class="param">runs: [[Number]] - Number of runs to do (Default: 10000)</dd>
<dt>Return Value:</dt>
<dd> [Execution time per run in microseconds as [[Number]], Execution time per run in microseconds as [[String]], number of runs]</dd>
</dl>
<h4>Examples</h4>
<dl><dt>Example 1:</dt><dd class="example"><code style="display: block">profileScript [{_a = 1 + 2 + 3}];</code></dd>
</dl>

</div>
